predictions: Seriously, how am I supposed to get these picks right? Last week, my pick for the match of the week left their best player at home. And in match #2, my pick not only left their best player at home, but they also left what might be their second best player at home too! Oh, come on, man. Then another of my picks played shorthanded. And another lost in a dang tiebreaker. Ugh. Somehow, I still went 19-7 for the week though, which brings me to 85-45 (65.4% correct) through five weeks.

Match of the week: (E Div.) Dartifacts @ Ton 80 Proof. Five weeks in, two flashy 5-0 records, both averaging over 16 per week, 2+ matches ahead of everyone else in the division. This is marquee matchup time if ever there has been one. Aside from matching close 13-11 wins over the 1-4 Rangers, they've both rolled team after team. But somehow I just feel like the Dartifacts are just destined to claim E. 'Facts, 14-10.

Match #2: (A Div.) Dart Vader @ Element W. In almost any other week, this is the headliner match (and still would have been if Show Me hadn't handed Vader a loss two weeks ago). This is thus round 2 of the showcase of firepower and talent not seen since the peak of the Element-Bullies series a few years ago (round 3 comes just next week). Scary one, but I have to stick with my own guys… Element, 13-11.

Match #3: (G Div.) Flight Club @ She-nanigans. These two are the two most recent victims in Salute's undefeated march to this point, but both are still well within reach of the G title chase. Flight Club has just dominated DCkt this season, so I'm happy to roll with them, 15-9.

Match #4: (C Div.) Nine Lives @ Pints & Points. The winner here moves to 4-2, and is immediately the primary competition for C's lead duo (Possee and Mafia). With Mafia facing the Possee next week, this is immediately kind of huge. I'm going with Niners in the last 501.

Match #5: (B Div.) Dart Attack @ Hump Day! The Humps already hold a two-match lead on everybody in B, with four teams exactly two losses behind. If they can hand those particular four teams another loss, that would end any drama. Tough one, but still Hump, 14-10.

Match #6: (E Div.) Cheap Shots @ Dart Knights. I admit that I'm a bit stunned that these teams are each only 2-3. With both the teams in the match of the week coming in at 5-0, it's kind of last call for a title run. I'm taking the Dart Knights to take that last chance, 13-11.

Match #7: (A Div.) The Outlaws @ Inconsistent Consistently. Is this The Outlaws' first win back in A? Or is Inconsistent staking a claim to a spot in the league's top four? Could go either way, but I feel like Inconsistent is really on the come up. This will be IC, 14-10.

Match #8: (F Div.) Death Throw @ Sharky's Machine. Machine has been super under-the-radar so far, but they are 3-2 with tight 13-11 losses to both of the teams ahead of them. Maybe it's their lack of ASPs (bottom five in the league) that has kept them out of the spotlight. But they're still about to move to 4-2 here… 14-10.

Match #9: (D Div.) Duck Fook @ That's What She Said. There are no D teams with 0 losses, and no D teams with 0 wins. So while a pair of 2-3 teams are certainly trying to avoid the basement, the winner might also still be in the title chase. Ducks, barely… 13-11.
Match #10: (B Div.) Darty Little Secrets @ Wing & a Plaque. A logjam of four teams sit with two losses each in the fight to be the top chaser of Hump Day. I like the Secrets, but this is Wing, 14-10.
Match #11: (G Div.) Throwin' on the Bayou @ Double Vision. Is this where the Bayou breaks through for their first of the season? Maybe… but I think I'm feeling Double Vision in this tangle, 14-10.

Match #12: (C Div.) Mulligan's Mafia @ Darty Sanchez. Mafia gets their shot at the Possee next week, but they had better not look past Sanchez in this one first. Mafia wins, but it will be close, 13-11.
